project_name.justification: The authoritative project name is Root Lake South. The text refers to the project as the 'Root South property': '...Xplore will expand its land position along the Root Lake lithium trend with its option to the Root South property...'

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the text: 'Xplore Resources Corp. (TSXV: XPLR)("Xplore" or the "Company") is pleased to announce it has entered into an assignment agreement...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Xplore Resources Corp., is listed at the end of the press release: 'ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, Dominic Verdejo, CEO Xplore Resources Corp.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Xplore is acquiring the option to obtain a 100% interest in the property. 'Pursuant to the Option Agreement, the Optionors granted to LONE the exclusive right and option (the "Option") to acquire 100% of the rights, title and interest of the Optionors in and to certain mineral claims...'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as being in a lithium district: 'Xplore Resources is a North American lithium exploration company... The company has a prospective land package in the emerging Root Bay lithium district...'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Xplore Resources Expands Land Position at Surge Lithium Project' and details the option agreement for the Root South Property, which is the project of interest.

currency.justification: The payments are denominated in '$' and the acquiring company, Xplore Resources Corp., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), which implies Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is $267,500, comprising an aggregate payment of $67,500 to the Optionors ($29,000 + $38,500) and an assignment fee of $200,000 to LONE. Text: 'pay to the Optionors an aggregate of $29,000...pay an additional $38,500 in cash to the Optionors...pay an assignment fee of $200,000 to LONE in cash'.

share_payments_raw.justification: No explicit monetary value for the share payment is provided in the text; the consideration is described as a number of shares.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the deal are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total shares to be issued is 790,000, comprising an initial 260,000 shares and an additional 530,000 shares to the Optionors. Text: 'issue to the Optionors an aggregate of 260,000 common shares of the Company...on or prior to January 11, 2025, the Company will issue an additional 530,000 Xplore Shares'.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction terms for the Root South Property.

option_payments_raw.justification: No stock options are mentioned as part of the transaction payments for the Root South Property.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.015'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in meters is mentioned for the Root South Property.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No monetary exploration commitment is mentioned for the Root South Property.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction is subject to a 2% net smelter returns royalty retained by the Optionors. Text: 'subject to a net smelter returns royalty of 2% to the Optionors (payable on commencement of commercial production)'.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The Root South Property is comprised of 175 claims over 3,570 ha.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The Root South Property is comprised of 175 claims over 3,570 ha.

resource_size.justification: The text mentions a resource of '10 Mt at 1.29% Li2O', but this resource belongs to the adjacent 'Green Technology Metals Ltd.'s Root Bay Project', not the Root South Property which is the project of interest.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph: 'Xplore Resources Corp. (TSXV: XPLR)'.
